BALOCHISTAN ARCHIVES DEPARTMENT (GRADE-16 AND ABOVE) SERVICE RULES, 1983
BALOCHISTAN ARCHIVES DEPARTMENT (GRADE-16 AND ABOVE) SERVICE RULES, 1983
(Amendment of Appendix)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 5th September, 2012]
No.S.O.(R-II)(22)40/2012-S&GAD/1627-1700,
dated 5-9-2012.---In exercise of the powers
conferred by Section 25 of the Balochistan Civil Servants Act, 1974 (Act No. IX
of 1974), the Government of Balochistan is pleased to make the following
amendments in the Balochistan Archives Department (Grade-16 and above) Service
Rules, 1983, namely:--
In the
aforesaid rules, in appendix, against serial No.8, in column 4, for the
existing entries the following shall be substituted:--
"By
promotion from amongst the members of the Subordinate Service holding the post
of Senior Scale Stenographer (BPS-15) and Assistant (BPS-14) having at least
three (3) years service as such, on seniority cum fitness basis.
For the
purpose of promotion a combined seniority list of Senior Scale Stenographer
(BPS-15) and Assistant (BPS-14) shall be maintained from the date of regular
appointment in the respective category.".
